title: Sainik School AISSEE Class 6 · Expected Paper 3 (2027)
description: Expected AISSEE Class 6 paper for 2027: English 25, Mathematics 50, Intelligence 25 and General Knowledge 25 questions (125 questions, 300 marks, 150 minutes, no negative marking). Original practice paper on the AISSEE pattern (not the official paper). Free.

questions.text: Choose the word that is closest in meaning to HUGE.
questions.explanation: "Huge" means very big; "enormous" means the same.

questions.text: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to GENEROUS.
questions.explanation: A generous person shares freely; the opposite is a selfish person.

questions.text: Fill in the blank with the correct article: ___ sun rises in the east.
questions.explanation: There is only one sun, so we use "the".

questions.text: Fill in the blank: The train arrived ___ 6 o'clock.
questions.explanation: We use "at" with an exact time of the clock.

questions.text: Fill in the blank: Look! The children ___ in the park.
questions.explanation: "Look!" shows the action is happening now, so we use the present continuous "are playing".

questions.text: What is the plural of LEAF?
questions.explanation: Many words ending in -f change to -ves in the plural: leaf → leaves.

questions.text: One word for "a place where books are kept for people to read or borrow" is:
questions.explanation: A library is a place where books are kept for reading and borrowing.

questions.text: Choose the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is n-e-c-e-s-s-a-r-y (one c, double s).

questions.text: What is the feminine of KING?
questions.explanation: The feminine of king is queen. (Princess is the feminine of prince.)

questions.text: Fill in the blank with the correct pronoun: This book is ___. I bought it yesterday.
questions.explanation: We need a possessive pronoun that stands alone: "This book is mine."

questions.text: Pick out the adverb in this sentence: She sang sweetly at the function.
questions.explanation: "Sweetly" tells us how she sang, so it is an adverb.

questions.text: The idiom "to let the cat out of the bag" means:
options: to tell a secret by mistake
questions.explanation: To "let the cat out of the bag" is to reveal a secret, usually without meaning to.

questions.text: Arrange the words to make a correct sentence: P: The   Q: is   R: blue   S: sky
questions.explanation: The sentence is "The sky is blue" = P S Q R.

questions.text: Choose the correct sentence.
options: She lived here since for five years.
She is living here since five years.
She has been living here since five years.
She has been living here for five years.
questions.explanation: For a length of time ("five years") we use "for", with the present perfect continuous "has been living".

questions.text: Choose the correct question tag: He can swim, ___?
questions.explanation: A positive sentence with "can" takes the negative tag "can't he?".

questions.text: Fill in the blank with the correct collective noun: a ___ of cattle
questions.explanation: A group of cattle is called a herd.

questions.text: Fill in the blank: Rohan is the ___ boy in our class.
questions.explanation: When one is compared with all the others in a group, we use the superlative "tallest".

questions.text: Fill in the blank with a suitable joining word: Hurry up, ___ you will miss the bus.
questions.explanation: "Or" here means "otherwise": hurry up, otherwise you will miss the bus.

questions.text: Choose the word that is closest in meaning to BEGIN.
questions.explanation: "Begin" and "start" mean the same.

questions.text: Change into indirect speech: Mother said, "I am busy."
options: Mother said that I was busy.
Mother said that she is busy.
Mother said that she was busy.
Mother said that she has busy.
questions.explanation: In indirect speech "I" becomes "she" and the present "am" changes to the past "was".

questions.text: What does the grandfather say about the tree?
options: It was cut down long ago.
It was a small plant when he was a boy.
It was already huge when he was a little boy.
questions.explanation: The passage says grandfather remembers that it "was already huge when he was a little boy".
questions.passage: At the edge of our village stands an old banyan tree. Nobody knows exactly how old it is, but my grandfather says it was already huge when he was a little boy. Its thick branches spread out in every direction, and from them hang long roots that reach down into the soil. These roots slowly become new trunks, so the tree looks like a small forest by itself. In the afternoon, farmers rest in its cool shade, and the village elders sit on a stone platform beneath it to talk. Parrots, mynas and squirrels make their homes in its branches, and in summer many birds come to eat its small red figs. Children swing on the hanging roots and play hide-and-seek between the trunks. Last year, when some people wanted to cut down the tree to widen the road, the whole village said no. The road was built around the tree instead.

questions.text: What do the hanging roots of the banyan tree slowly become?
questions.explanation: The passage says "These roots slowly become new trunks".

The village refused and the road was built around the tree.
A new tree was planted in its place.
The children moved to another village.

questions.explanation: Using the common denominator 12: 10/12 − 3/12 = 7/12.
Dividing by a fraction means multiplying by its reciprocal: 7/8 × 16/7 = 16/8 = 2.
questions.explanationHi: भिन्न से भाग देने का अर्थ है उसके व्युत्क्रम से गुणा: 7/8 × 16/7 = 16/8 = 2।

questions.text: Which is the largest of these fractions: 2/3, 3/5, 5/8, 7/12?
A tank can hold 60 litres of water. It is 3/4 full. How many litres of water are in it?
questions.textHi: एक टंकी में 60 लीटर पानी आ सकता है। वह 3/4 भरी है। उसमें कितने लीटर पानी है?

questions.text: Seema spent 1/3 of her money on books and 1/4 of it on food. What fraction of her money is left?
questions.textHi: सीमा ने अपने पैसों का 1/3 भाग किताबों पर और 1/4 भाग भोजन पर खर्च किया। उसके पैसों का कितना भाग बचा?

questions.text: Which fraction is equal to 3/7 and has denominator 35?
questions.textHi: कौन-सी भिन्न 3/7 के बराबर है और जिसका हर 35 है?
questions.explanation: 35 = 7 × 5, so multiply the numerator by 5 too: 3 × 5 = 15, giving 15/35.

questions.text: What is 36/48 in its simplest form?
questions.textHi: 36/48 का सरलतम रूप क्या है?

questions.text: How is 4:45 p.m. written in the 24-hour clock?
questions.textHi: 24-घंटे की घड़ी में शाम 4:45 को कैसे लिखा जाता है?
questions.explanation: For p.m. times add 12 to the hour: 4 + 12 = 16, so 16:45.

questions.text: A train leaves at 9:40 a.m. and reaches at 2:15 p.m. on the same day. How long is the journey?
questions.textHi: एक रेलगाड़ी सुबह 9:40 पर चलती है और उसी दिन दोपहर 2:15 पर पहुँचती है। यात्रा कितने समय की है?
questions.explanation: From 9:40 to 10:00 is 20 min, 10:00 to 2:00 p.m. is 4 h, 2:00 to 2:15 is 15 min. Total = 4 h 35 min.

questions.text: What is the angle between the two hands of a clock at 6 o'clock?
questions.textHi: 6 बजे घड़ी की दोनों सुइयों के बीच कितना कोण होता है?
questions.explanation: At 6:00 the hands point in opposite directions (12 and 6), making a straight angle of 180°.
questions.explanationHi: 6:00 बजे सुइयाँ विपरीत दिशाओं में (12 और 6 पर) होती हैं, जिससे 180° का सरल कोण बनता है।

questions.text: What is the angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 2:30?
questions.textHi: 2:30 बजे घड़ी की घंटे की सुई और मिनट की सुई के बीच कितना कोण होता है?
questions.explanation: The minute hand is at 6 (180°). The hour hand is halfway between 2 and 3: 2.5 × 30° = 75°. Angle = 180° − 75° = 105°.

questions.text: How many complete rounds does the minute hand of a clock make from 8 a.m. to 2 p.m.?
questions.textHi: सुबह 8 बजे से दोपहर 2 बजे तक घड़ी की मिनट की सुई कितने पूरे चक्कर लगाती है?
questions.explanation: From 8 a.m. to 2 p.m. is 6 hours, and the minute hand makes one round every hour, so 6 rounds.
questions.explanationHi: सुबह 8 से दोपहर 2 बजे तक 6 घंटे हैं और मिनट की सुई हर घंटे एक चक्कर लगाती है, अतः 6 चक्कर।

questions.text: Through how many degrees does the hour hand of a clock turn in one hour?
questions.textHi: घड़ी की घंटे की सुई एक घंटे में कितने अंश घूमती है?
questions.explanation: The hour hand turns 360° in 12 hours, so in 1 hour it turns 360° ÷ 12 = 30°.

questions.text: How many seconds are there in 1 hour 15 minutes?
questions.textHi: 1 घंटे 15 मिनट में कितने सेकंड होते हैं?
questions.explanation: 1 h 15 min = 75 minutes, and 75 × 60 = 4500 seconds.

questions.text: How many days are there from 10 March to 15 April, counting both days?
questions.textHi: 10 मार्च से 15 अप्रैल तक (दोनों दिन मिलाकर) कितने दिन होते हैं?
questions.explanation: March 10 to 31 = 22 days (31 − 10 + 1). April 1 to 15 = 15 days. Total = 37 days.

questions.text: How many days are there in 6 weeks and 4 days?
questions.textHi: 6 सप्ताह और 4 दिन में कितने दिन होते हैं?
questions.explanation: 6 weeks = 6 × 7 = 42 days; 42 + 4 = 46 days.

questions.text: A square of side 4 m is cut out from one corner of a rectangular sheet 12 m long and 8 m wide. What is the area of the remaining sheet?
questions.textHi: 12 m लंबी और 8 m चौड़ी एक आयताकार चादर के एक कोने से 4 m भुजा का एक वर्ग काट दिया जाता है। बची हुई चादर का क्षेत्रफल क्या है?
questions.explanation: Rectangle = 12 × 8 = 96 m². Square cut = 4 × 4 = 16 m². Remaining = 96 − 16 = 80 m².

questions.text: Two squares, each of side 5 cm, are joined side by side to make a rectangle. What is the perimeter of the rectangle?
questions.textHi: 5 cm भुजा वाले दो वर्गों को साथ-साथ जोड़कर एक आयत बनाया गया है। आयत का परिमाप क्या है?
questions.explanation: The rectangle is 10 cm × 5 cm. Perimeter = 2 × (10 + 5) = 30 cm.
questions.explanationHi: आयत 10 cm × 5 cm का है। परिमाप = 2 × (10 + 5) = 30 cm।

questions.text: A rectangular garden is 20 m long and 15 m wide. A path 2 m wide runs all around it on the outside. What is the area of the path?
questions.textHi: एक आयताकार बगीचा 20 m लंबा और 15 m चौड़ा है। इसके चारों ओर बाहर की तरफ़ 2 m चौड़ा रास्ता है। रास्ते का क्षेत्रफल क्या है?

questions.text: A shape is made of a rectangle 8 cm × 6 cm with a triangle on top of it. The triangle has base 8 cm and height 3 cm. What is the total area of the shape?
questions.textHi: एक आकृति 8 cm × 6 cm के आयत और उसके ऊपर बने एक त्रिभुज से मिलकर बनी है। त्रिभुज का आधार 8 cm और ऊँचाई 3 cm है। आकृति का कुल क्षेत्रफल क्या है?
questions.explanation: Rectangle = 8 × 6 = 48 cm². Triangle = 1/2 × 8 × 3 = 12 cm². Total = 48 + 12 = 60 cm².

questions.text: The largest possible circle is drawn inside a square of side 14 cm. What is the area of the part of the square outside the circle? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.textHi: 14 cm भुजा वाले वर्ग के अंदर सबसे बड़ा संभव वृत्त बनाया गया है। वर्ग के उस भाग का क्षेत्रफल क्या है जो वृत्त के बाहर है? (π = 22/7 लीजिए)
questions.explanation: Square = 14 × 14 = 196 cm². Circle has radius 7 cm: 22/7 × 7 × 7 = 154 cm². Outside part = 196 − 154 = 42 cm².

questions.text: How many square tiles of side 50 cm are needed to cover the floor of a room 5 m long and 4 m wide?
questions.textHi: 5 m लंबे और 4 m चौड़े कमरे के फ़र्श को ढकने के लिए 50 cm भुजा वाली कितनी वर्गाकार टाइलें चाहिए?
questions.explanation: Along the length: 500 ÷ 50 = 10 tiles; along the width: 400 ÷ 50 = 8 tiles. Total = 10 × 8 = 80 tiles.

questions.text: The area of a square is 64 cm². What is its perimeter?
questions.textHi: एक वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल 64 cm² है। उसका परिमाप क्या है?
questions.explanation: Side = 8 cm because 8 × 8 = 64. Perimeter = 4 × 8 = 32 cm.

questions.text: What is the HCF of 36 and 60?
questions.textHi: 36 और 60 का HCF क्या है?
questions.explanation: 36 = 2² × 3², 60 = 2² × 3 × 5. Common factors: 2² × 3 = 12.

questions.text: What is the LCM of 9 and 12?
questions.textHi: 9 और 12 का LCM क्या है?

questions.text: If 12 bananas cost ₹60, how much will 20 bananas cost?
questions.textHi: यदि 12 केलों का मूल्य ₹60 है, तो 20 केलों का मूल्य क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: One banana = 60 ÷ 12 = ₹5. 20 bananas = 20 × 5 = ₹100.

questions.text: What is the ratio 45 : 60 in its simplest form?
questions.textHi: अनुपात 45 : 60 का सरलतम रूप क्या है?
questions.explanation: Divide both by their HCF 15: 45 ÷ 15 = 3, 60 ÷ 15 = 4, so 3 : 4.

questions.text: A watch bought for ₹850 is sold for ₹765. What is the loss per cent?
questions.textHi: ₹850 में खरीदी गई एक घड़ी ₹765 में बेची जाती है। हानि प्रतिशत क्या है?

questions.text: What will be the amount on ₹2400 at 5% simple interest per year after 2 years?
questions.textHi: ₹2400 पर 5% वार्षिक साधारण ब्याज की दर से 2 वर्ष बाद मिश्रधन कितना होगा?

questions.text: Aman scored 18 marks out of 24. What is his score as a percentage?
questions.textHi: अमन ने 24 में से 18 अंक प्राप्त किए। उसके अंक प्रतिशत में कितने हैं?

questions.text: What is the volume of a cuboid 12 cm long, 5 cm wide and 4 cm high?
questions.textHi: 12 cm लंबे, 5 cm चौड़े और 4 cm ऊँचे घनाभ का आयतन क्या है?
questions.explanation: Volume = 12 × 5 × 4 = 240 cm³.

questions.text: Convert 77 °F into degrees Celsius. (C = 5 × (F − 32) ÷ 9)
4 litres 250 mL is equal to:
questions.textHi: 4 लीटर 250 mL बराबर है:

questions.explanation: 6 × 5 = 30, and there are 3 decimal places in all: 0.030 = 0.03.

questions.text: The Roman numeral LXXVIII stands for:
questions.textHi: रोमन अंक LXXVIII किस संख्या को दर्शाता है?
questions.explanation: L = 50, XX = 20, VIII = 8, so LXXVIII = 78.
questions.explanationHi: L = 50, XX = 20, VIII = 8, अतः LXXVIII = 78।

questions.text: How is the year 2024 written in Roman numerals?
questions.textHi: वर्ष 2024 को रोमन अंकों में कैसे लिखा जाता है?
questions.explanation: 2000 = MM, 20 = XX, 4 = IV, so 2024 = MMXXIV.
questions.explanationHi: 2000 = MM, 20 = XX, 4 = IV, अतः 2024 = MMXXIV।

questions.text: The average age of 4 children is 9 years. When their teacher is included, the average age becomes 14 years. What is the age of the teacher?
questions.textHi: 4 बच्चों की औसत आयु 9 वर्ष है। उनके शिक्षक को मिलाने पर औसत आयु 14 वर्ष हो जाती है। शिक्षक की आयु क्या है?
questions.explanation: Children's total = 4 × 9 = 36. Total of all 5 = 5 × 14 = 70. Teacher = 70 − 36 = 34 years.

questions.text: A cyclist rides at 18 km/h. What is this speed in metres per second?
questions.textHi: एक साइकिल सवार 18 km/h की चाल से चलता है। यह चाल मीटर प्रति सेकंड में कितनी है?

questions.text: How long will Kavya take to walk 2 km at a speed of 4 km/h?
questions.textHi: कव्या 4 km/h की चाल से 2 km चलने में कितना समय लेगी?
questions.explanation: Time = distance ÷ speed = 2 ÷ 4 = 1/2 hour = 30 minutes.

questions.text: Which is the smallest composite number?
questions.textHi: सबसे छोटी भाज्य संख्या कौन-सी है?
questions.explanation: 1 is neither prime nor composite, 2 and 3 are prime. 4 = 2 × 2 is the smallest composite number.
questions.explanationHi: 1 न अभाज्य है न भाज्य, 2 और 3 अभाज्य हैं। 4 = 2 × 2 सबसे छोटी भाज्य संख्या है।

questions.text: What is the sum of the first five prime numbers?
questions.textHi: पहली पाँच अभाज्य संख्याओं का योग क्या है?
questions.explanation: The first five primes are 2, 3, 5, 7, 11. Sum = 28.

questions.text: Two angles of a triangle are 50° and 60°. What is the third angle?
questions.textHi: एक त्रिभुज के दो कोण 50° और 60° हैं। तीसरा कोण क्या है?
questions.explanation: The angles of a triangle add up to 180°: 180° − (50° + 60°) = 70°.

questions.text: What is the supplement of an angle of 75°?
questions.textHi: 75° के कोण का संपूरक कोण क्या है?
questions.explanation: Supplementary angles add up to 180°: 180° − 75° = 105°.

questions.text: What is the circumference of a circle of radius 21 cm? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.textHi: 21 cm त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त की परिधि क्या है? (π = 22/7 लीजिए)
questions.explanation: Circumference = 2 × π × r = 2 × 22/7 × 21 = 132 cm.

questions.text: What is the difference between the place value and the face value of 6 in 3,64,782?
questions.textHi: 3,64,782 में 6 के स्थानीय मान और जातीय (अंकित) मान का अंतर क्या है?
questions.explanation: Place value of 6 = 60,000; face value = 6. Difference = 60,000 − 6 = 59,994.
Bracket first: 8 − 3 = 5. Then 5 × 5 = 25 and 12 ÷ 4 = 3. So 75 − 25 + 3 = 53.

questions.text: Bird : Nest :: Bee : ?
questions.textHi: पक्षी : घोंसला :: मधुमक्खी : ?
questions.explanation: A bird lives in a nest; a bee lives in a hive.
questions.explanationHi: पक्षी घोंसले में रहता है; मधुमक्खी छत्ते में।

questions.text: Find the missing term: 8 : 64 :: 11 : ?
questions.explanation: 64 is the square of 8 (8 × 8). The square of 11 is 121.

questions.text: Find the missing term: CAT : TAC :: PEN : ?
questions.textHi: लुप्त पद ज्ञात कीजिए: CAT : TAC :: PEN : ?
questions.explanation: TAC is CAT written backwards. PEN written backwards is NEP.
questions.explanationHi: TAC, CAT को उल्टा लिखने पर बनता है। PEN को उल्टा लिखने पर NEP।

questions.text: Find the odd one out.
questions.textHi: विषम को चुनिए।
questions.explanation: Copper, iron and silver are metals; wood is not a metal.
questions.explanationHi: ताँबा, लोहा और चाँदी धातुएँ हैं; लकड़ी धातु नहीं है।

questions.text: Find the odd number out: 21, 35, 49, 54
questions.explanation: 21, 35 and 49 are multiples of 7; 54 is not.

questions.text: What comes next in the series? 3, 7, 15, 31, ?
questions.explanation: Each term is doubled and 1 is added: 31 × 2 + 1 = 63.
questions.explanationHi: हर पद को दुगुना करके 1 जोड़ा गया है: 31 × 2 + 1 = 63।

questions.text: What comes next in the series? AZ, BY, CX, ?
questions.textHi: श्रेणी में अगला पद क्या है? AZ, BY, CX, ?
questions.explanation: The first letter moves forward (A, B, C, D) and the second moves backward (Z, Y, X, W): DW.
questions.explanationHi: पहला अक्षर आगे बढ़ता है (A, B, C, D) और दूसरा पीछे जाता है (Z, Y, X, W): DW।

questions.text: If MANGO is written as NBOHP in a code, how will APPLE be written in that code?
questions.textHi: यदि किसी कूट भाषा में MANGO को NBOHP लिखा जाता है, तो उसी भाषा में APPLE को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
questions.explanation: Each letter is moved one step forward: A→B, P→Q, P→Q, L→M, E→F, giving BQQMF.
questions.explanationHi: हर अक्षर एक कदम आगे: A→B, P→Q, P→Q, L→M, E→F, अतः BQQMF।

questions.text: If "sky" is called "sea", "sea" is called "water", "water" is called "air" and "air" is called "cloud", then where do fish live?
questions.textHi: यदि "आकाश" को "समुद्र", "समुद्र" को "पानी", "पानी" को "हवा" और "हवा" को "बादल" कहा जाए, तो मछलियाँ कहाँ रहती हैं?
questions.explanation: Fish live in water, and "water" is called "air" in this code.
questions.explanationHi: मछलियाँ पानी में रहती हैं, और इस कूट में "पानी" को "हवा" कहा जाता है।

questions.text: Meena is facing east. She turns left, then turns left again, and then turns right. Which direction is she facing now?
questions.textHi: मीना पूर्व की ओर मुँह करके खड़ी है। वह बाएँ मुड़ती है, फिर दोबारा बाएँ मुड़ती है और फिर दाएँ मुड़ती है। अब उसका मुँह किस दिशा में है?
questions.explanation: East → left → North → left → West → right → North.
questions.explanationHi: पूर्व → बाएँ → उत्तर → बाएँ → पश्चिम → दाएँ → उत्तर।

questions.text: Kabir walks 6 km towards the south and then 8 km towards the east. How far is he now from his starting point in a straight line?
questions.textHi: कबीर 6 km दक्षिण की ओर और फिर 8 km पूर्व की ओर चलता है। अब वह अपने आरंभिक स्थान से सीधी रेखा में कितनी दूर है?
questions.explanation: The two paths make a right angle. Straight distance = √(6² + 8²) = √(36 + 64) = √100 = 10 km.

questions.text: Pointing to a girl, a man said, "She is the daughter of my father's only son." How is the girl related to the man?
questions.textHi: एक लड़की की ओर इशारा करते हुए एक आदमी ने कहा, "वह मेरे पिता के इकलौते बेटे की बेटी है।" लड़की का उस आदमी से क्या संबंध है?
questions.explanation: The only son of the man's father is the man himself. So the girl is his own daughter.
questions.explanationHi: आदमी के पिता का इकलौता बेटा वह आदमी स्वयं है। अतः लड़की उसकी अपनी बेटी है।

questions.text: How is Rahul's mother's father related to Rahul?
questions.textHi: राहुल की माँ के पिता का राहुल से क्या संबंध है?
questions.explanation: The father of one's mother is one's (maternal) grandfather, nana.
questions.explanationHi: माँ के पिता नाना होते हैं।

questions.text: Find the missing number: 5, 10, 20, 40, ?
questions.explanation: Each number is double the one before it: 40 × 2 = 80.
questions.explanationHi: हर संख्या पिछली की दुगुनी है: 40 × 2 = 80।

questions.text: Find the missing number. Row 1: 3, 4, 14   Row 2: 5, 2, 14   Row 3: 6, 3, ?
In a class, Priya is 8th from the top and 14th from the bottom. How many students are there in the class?
questions.textHi: एक कक्षा में प्रिया ऊपर से 8वें और नीचे से 14वें स्थान पर है। कक्षा में कितने विद्यार्थी हैं?
questions.explanation: Total = 8 + 14 − 1 = 21 (Priya is counted twice, so subtract 1).
questions.explanationHi: कुल = 8 + 14 − 1 = 21 (प्रिया दो बार गिनी गई, इसलिए 1 घटाया)।

questions.text: Today is Wednesday. What day of the week will it be after 45 days?
questions.textHi: आज बुधवार है। 45 दिन बाद सप्ताह का कौन-सा दिन होगा?
questions.explanation: 45 = 6 weeks + 3 days. Three days after Wednesday is Saturday.
questions.explanationHi: 45 = 6 सप्ताह + 3 दिन। बुधवार के 3 दिन बाद शनिवार।

questions.text: If "×" means "+", "+" means "÷", "−" means "×" and "÷" means "−", what is the value of 16 + 4 × 3 − 2 ÷ 5?
questions.explanation: Replacing the signs: 16 ÷ 4 + 3 × 2 − 5 = 4 + 6 − 5 = 5.

questions.text: If these words are arranged in dictionary order, which word comes third? Banana, Bangle, Balloon, Basket
questions.textHi: यदि इन शब्दों को शब्दकोश के क्रम में लगाया जाए, तो तीसरा शब्द कौन-सा होगा? Banana, Bangle, Balloon, Basket
questions.explanation: Dictionary order: Balloon, Banana, Bangle, Basket. The third word is Bangle.
questions.explanationHi: शब्दकोश क्रम: Balloon, Banana, Bangle, Basket। तीसरा शब्द Bangle है।

questions.text: Water is below the problem figure, as shown by the dashed line. Which answer figure is its water image (reflection in water)?
questions.textHi: प्रश्न आकृति के नीचे पानी है, जैसा कि टूटी रेखा से दिखाया गया है। कौन-सी उत्तर आकृति इसका जल प्रतिबिंब है?
questions.explanation: In a water image, top and bottom swap but left and right stay the same. The steps that went up to the top-right now go down to the bottom-right, and the black dot moves from the bottom-right to the top-right: Figure (C).
questions.explanationHi: जल प्रतिबिंब में ऊपर-नीचे बदल जाते हैं पर बायाँ-दायाँ वही रहता है। जो सीढ़ियाँ ऊपर-दाएँ जाती थीं, अब नीचे-दाएँ जाती हैं, और काला बिंदु नीचे-दाएँ से ऊपर-दाएँ आ जाता है: आकृति (C)।

questions.text: Select the figure which is different from the others.
questions.textHi: उस आकृति को चुनिए जो अन्य से भिन्न है।
questions.explanation: In (B), (C) and (D) the two shaded quarters are next to each other (one figure turned). In (A) the shaded quarters are opposite each other.
questions.explanationHi: (B), (C) और (D) में दोनों छायांकित चौथाई भाग पास-पास हैं (एक ही आकृति घुमाई गई है)। (A) में छायांकित भाग आमने-सामने हैं।

questions.text: Which answer figure will continue the series of problem figures?
questions.textHi: कौन-सी उत्तर आकृति प्रश्न आकृतियों की श्रृंखला को आगे बढ़ाएगी?
questions.explanation: Each figure has one more side than the one before (3, 4, 5, so next 6), and the shading alternates: white, black, white, so next is black. A black hexagon is Figure (C).
questions.explanationHi: हर आकृति में पिछली से एक भुजा अधिक है (3, 4, 5, अतः अगली 6), और रंग बारी-बारी से बदलता है: सफ़ेद, काला, सफ़ेद, अतः अगला काला। काला षट्भुज आकृति (C) है।

questions.text: A square sheet of paper is folded along the dotted line (left half onto the right half) and then a hole is punched, as shown in the problem figures. How will the paper look when it is unfolded?
questions.textHi: एक वर्गाकार कागज़ को बिंदुदार रेखा पर मोड़ा जाता है (बायाँ आधा भाग दाएँ आधे भाग पर) और फिर उसमें एक छेद किया जाता है, जैसा प्रश्न आकृतियों में दिखाया गया है। खोलने पर कागज़ कैसा दिखेगा?
questions.explanation: The hole goes through both layers. When the paper is opened, a second hole appears on the left half, exactly opposite the first one across the fold line, at the same height: Figure (B).
questions.explanationHi: छेद दोनों परतों में से होकर जाता है। खोलने पर बाएँ आधे भाग में भी, मोड़ की रेखा के ठीक सामने और उसी ऊँचाई पर, दूसरा छेद दिखेगा: आकृति (B)।

questions.text: A piece is missing from the square in the problem figure (shown by the dashed lines). Which answer figure exactly fits the gap to complete the square?
questions.textHi: प्रश्न आकृति के वर्ग में से एक टुकड़ा गायब है (टूटी रेखाओं से दिखाया गया)। कौन-सी उत्तर आकृति खाली जगह में ठीक बैठकर वर्ग को पूरा करेगी?
questions.explanation: The gap is a right-angled triangle with its two equal straight sides along the top and right edges of the square and its right angle at the top-right corner. Only Figure (D) has this shape and size.
questions.explanationHi: खाली जगह एक समकोण त्रिभुज है जिसकी दो बराबर भुजाएँ वर्ग के ऊपरी और दाएँ किनारे पर हैं और समकोण ऊपर-दाएँ कोने पर है। केवल आकृति (D) का यही आकार और माप है।

questions.text: How many squares are there in the figure?
questions.textHi: आकृति में कितने वर्ग हैं?
questions.explanation: There are 6 small squares. There are also 2 bigger squares, each made of 2 × 2 small squares (the left four and the right four). Total = 6 + 2 = 8.
questions.explanationHi: 6 छोटे वर्ग हैं। इसके अलावा 2 बड़े वर्ग भी हैं, हर एक 2 × 2 छोटे वर्गों से बना (बाईं ओर के चार और दाईं ओर के चार)। कुल = 6 + 2 = 8।

questions.text: Which is the largest continent in the world?
questions.textHi: विश्व का सबसे बड़ा महाद्वीप कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Asia is the largest continent, both in area and in population.
questions.explanationHi: एशिया क्षेत्रफल और जनसंख्या दोनों में सबसे बड़ा महाद्वीप है।

questions.text: Which is the largest and deepest ocean in the world?
questions.textHi: विश्व का सबसे बड़ा और सबसे गहरा महासागर कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean.
questions.explanationHi: प्रशांत महासागर सबसे बड़ा और सबसे गहरा महासागर है।

questions.text: Which is the smallest continent?
questions.textHi: सबसे छोटा महाद्वीप कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Australia is the smallest continent.
questions.explanationHi: ऑस्ट्रेलिया सबसे छोटा महाद्वीप है।

questions.text: The Sahara, the largest hot desert in the world, is in which continent?
questions.textHi: विश्व का सबसे बड़ा गर्म रेगिस्तान सहारा किस महाद्वीप में है?
questions.explanation: The Sahara Desert covers a large part of northern Africa.
questions.explanationHi: सहारा रेगिस्तान उत्तरी अफ़्रीका के बड़े भाग में फैला है।

questions.text: Which ocean lies to the south of India?
questions.textHi: भारत के दक्षिण में कौन-सा महासागर है?
questions.explanation: The Indian Ocean lies to the south of India; it is the only ocean named after a country.
questions.explanationHi: भारत के दक्षिण में हिंद महासागर है; यह किसी देश के नाम पर रखा गया एकमात्र महासागर है।

questions.text: Which continent is almost completely covered with ice and has no permanent population?
questions.textHi: कौन-सा महाद्वीप लगभग पूरा बर्फ़ से ढका है और वहाँ कोई स्थायी आबादी नहीं है?
questions.explanation: Antarctica, around the South Pole, is the coldest continent; only scientists stay there for some time.
questions.explanationHi: दक्षिणी ध्रुव के आसपास स्थित अंटार्कटिका सबसे ठंडा महाद्वीप है; वहाँ केवल वैज्ञानिक कुछ समय के लिए रहते हैं।

questions.text: How many continents are there on the Earth?
questions.textHi: पृथ्वी पर कितने महाद्वीप हैं?
questions.explanation: There are 7 continents: Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe and Australia.
questions.explanationHi: 7 महाद्वीप हैं: एशिया, अफ़्रीका, उत्तरी अमेरिका, दक्षिणी अमेरिका, अंटार्कटिका, यूरोप और ऑस्ट्रेलिया।

questions.text: The Amazon river and rainforest are in which continent?
questions.textHi: अमेज़न नदी और वर्षावन किस महाद्वीप में हैं?
questions.explanation: The Amazon flows through South America, mostly through Brazil.
questions.explanationHi: अमेज़न नदी दक्षिण अमेरिका में, मुख्यतः ब्राज़ील से होकर बहती है।

questions.text: Which is the smallest ocean in the world?
questions.textHi: विश्व का सबसे छोटा महासागर कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: The Arctic Ocean, around the North Pole, is the smallest ocean.
questions.explanationHi: उत्तरी ध्रुव के आसपास स्थित आर्कटिक महासागर सबसे छोटा महासागर है।

questions.text: The sitar is which kind of musical instrument?
questions.textHi: सितार किस प्रकार का वाद्य यंत्र है?
questions.explanation: The sitar is played by plucking its strings, so it is a string instrument.
questions.explanationHi: सितार उसके तारों को छेड़कर बजाया जाता है, इसलिए यह तार वाद्य है।

questions.text: Ustad Zakir Hussain was world famous for playing the:
questions.textHi: उस्ताद ज़ाकिर हुसैन किस वाद्य को बजाने के लिए विश्व प्रसिद्ध थे?
questions.explanation: Ustad Zakir Hussain was a great tabla player.
questions.explanationHi: उस्ताद ज़ाकिर हुसैन महान तबला वादक थे।

questions.text: Pandit Ravi Shankar made Indian music popular across the world by playing the:
questions.textHi: पंडित रवि शंकर ने किस वाद्य को बजाकर भारतीय संगीत को पूरे विश्व में लोकप्रिय बनाया?
questions.explanation: Pandit Ravi Shankar was a legendary sitar player and a Bharat Ratna awardee.
questions.explanationHi: पंडित रवि शंकर महान सितार वादक थे और उन्हें भारत रत्न मिला था।

questions.text: Ustad Bismillah Khan is remembered as a master of which instrument?
questions.textHi: उस्ताद बिस्मिल्लाह ख़ाँ किस वाद्य के उस्ताद के रूप में याद किए जाते हैं?
questions.explanation: Ustad Bismillah Khan made the shehnai famous; he received the Bharat Ratna in 2001.
questions.explanationHi: उस्ताद बिस्मिल्लाह ख़ाँ ने शहनाई को प्रसिद्ध किया; उन्हें 2001 में भारत रत्न मिला।

questions.text: Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia is a famous player of the:
questions.textHi: पंडित हरिप्रसाद चौरसिया किस वाद्य के प्रसिद्ध वादक हैं?
questions.explanation: Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia is a world-famous bansuri (bamboo flute) player.
questions.explanationHi: पंडित हरिप्रसाद चौरसिया विश्व प्रसिद्ध बाँसुरी वादक हैं।

questions.text: Carnatic music is the classical music tradition of which part of India?
questions.textHi: कर्नाटक संगीत भारत के किस भाग की शास्त्रीय संगीत परंपरा है?
questions.explanation: Indian classical music has two main styles: Hindustani (North India) and Carnatic (South India).
questions.explanationHi: भारतीय शास्त्रीय संगीत की दो मुख्य शैलियाँ हैं: हिंदुस्तानी (उत्तर भारत) और कर्नाटक (दक्षिण भारत)।

questions.text: Goddess Saraswati is usually shown holding which musical instrument?
questions.textHi: देवी सरस्वती को प्रायः कौन-सा वाद्य यंत्र पकड़े हुए दिखाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: Goddess Saraswati, the goddess of learning and music, is shown playing the veena.
questions.explanationHi: विद्या और संगीत की देवी सरस्वती को वीणा बजाते हुए दिखाया जाता है।

questions.text: Lata Mangeshkar, who received the Bharat Ratna in 2001, was a famous:
questions.textHi: 2001 में भारत रत्न पाने वाली लता मंगेशकर एक प्रसिद्ध _____ थीं।
questions.explanation: Lata Mangeshkar sang thousands of film songs in many Indian languages.
questions.explanationHi: लता मंगेशकर ने कई भारतीय भाषाओं में हज़ारों फ़िल्मी गीत गाए।

questions.text: Who wrote India's national anthem, "Jana Gana Mana"?
questions.textHi: भारत का राष्ट्रगान "जन गण मन" किसने लिखा?
questions.explanation: Rabindranath Tagore wrote "Jana Gana Mana". (Bankim Chandra wrote the national song "Vande Mataram".)
questions.explanationHi: "जन गण मन" रवींद्रनाथ टैगोर ने लिखा। (राष्ट्रगीत "वंदे मातरम्" बंकिमचंद्र ने लिखा।)

questions.text: Which planet is known as the "Red Planet"?
questions.textHi: किस ग्रह को "लाल ग्रह" कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: Mars looks red because of iron oxide (rust) in its soil.
questions.explanationHi: मंगल की मिट्टी में आयरन ऑक्साइड (जंग) होने के कारण यह लाल दिखता है।

questions.text: Which organ of our body pumps blood to all its parts?
questions.textHi: हमारे शरीर का कौन-सा अंग पूरे शरीर में रक्त पंप करता है?
questions.explanation: The heart is a muscular pump that sends blood to all parts of the body.
questions.explanationHi: हृदय एक मांसपेशीय पंप है जो शरीर के सभी भागों में रक्त भेजता है।

questions.text: The green colour of leaves is due to a pigment called:
questions.textHi: पत्तियों का हरा रंग किस वर्णक के कारण होता है?
questions.explanation: Chlorophyll gives leaves their green colour and helps them make food using sunlight.
questions.explanationHi: क्लोरोफ़िल पत्तियों को हरा रंग देता है और सूर्य के प्रकाश से भोजन बनाने में मदद करता है।

questions.text: The National Defence Academy (NDA), where cadets of the Army, Navy and Air Force train together, is at:
questions.textHi: राष्ट्रीय रक्षा अकादमी (NDA), जहाँ थल सेना, नौसेना और वायु सेना के कैडेट साथ प्रशिक्षण लेते हैं, कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.explanation: The NDA is at Khadakwasla near Pune in Maharashtra.
questions.explanationHi: NDA महाराष्ट्र में पुणे के पास खड़कवासला में है।

questions.text: The Summer Olympic Games are normally held once every:
questions.textHi: ग्रीष्मकालीन ओलंपिक खेल सामान्यतः कितने वर्षों में एक बार होते हैं?
questions.explanation: The Summer Olympics are held every four years.
questions.explanationHi: ग्रीष्मकालीन ओलंपिक हर चार वर्ष में होते हैं।

questions.text: What is the national bird of India?
questions.textHi: भारत का राष्ट्रीय पक्षी कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: The Indian peacock is the national bird of India.
questions.explanationHi: भारतीय मोर भारत का राष्ट्रीय पक्षी है।

questions.text: When ice melts into water, matter changes from:
questions.textHi: जब बर्फ़ पिघलकर पानी बनती है, तो पदार्थ किस अवस्था से किस अवस्था में बदलता है?
questions.explanation: Ice is a solid; when it melts it becomes liquid water.
questions.explanationHi: बर्फ़ ठोस है; पिघलने पर वह द्रव (पानी) बन जाती है।
